parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the WAF instance.
You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query instance ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:
cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland
ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud resource group
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

Cause.description_en:
The cause of the alerting. If the Alarm Metric is sandbox (Type is set to sandbox), valid values are:

fivefold: The clean queries per second (QPS) exceeds the current specifications.
4count: The accumulated actual clean QPS exceeds the current specifications.
exceed10w: The actual peak clean QPS exceeds 100,000.
costProtection: Billing protection is triggered
Cause.description_zh:
告警原因。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，取值为：

fivefold: 表示业务的QPS已超过当前规格。
4count：表示实际业务请求数QPS已累计超过当前规格。
exceed10w: 表示实际业务请求峰值QPS已超过10万。
costProtection: 表示触发计费保护

Count.description_en:
The usage when alerting is triggered.

If the Alarm Metric is sandbox (Type is set to sandbox), this parameter indicates the number of days the quota is exceeded
Count.description_zh:
告警时使用量。

当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示超用的天数

Status.description_en:
The alerting status. Valid values:
true: Alerting is triggered. If the Alarm Metric is sandbox (Type is set to sandbox), the instance is in the sandbox.
false: No alerting is triggered. If the Alarm Metric is sandbox (Type is set to sandbox), the instance is not in the sandbox
Status.description_zh:
告警状态。取值为：
true：表示告警中。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示在沙箱中。
false：表示未告警。当告警类型为沙箱（Type取值为sandbox）时，表示未在沙箱中

Type.description_en:
The Alarm Metric. Valid values:

sandbox: sandbox alerting
Type.description_zh:
告警类型。取值：

sandbox：表示沙箱告警
